description: #1209 PR-2 — rows persisted before the rename spell the template key `workflow_id`. `calm_types::Wave` carries a deserialize-only `serde(alias)`, so replay still recovers the template attribution; re-serialization emits only the new `template_id` spelling. Step 3 (canonical is a serde fixed point) is what proves the alias is one-way. Deleting the alias makes step 1 hydrate `template_id: null` and this test goes red.
